name: PRD to Prototype
description: Turn a one-line product idea into a PRD and a high-fidelity interactive prototype through a forced two-step flow: PRD first, prototype second. Operates in a no-questions mode, filling in detail from industry convention and stating assumptions explicitly, with mobile or desktop platform choice. Use this skill when the request starts from a rough product idea and asks for a document plus a clickable page in one pass.
